purpose: Coverage categories and scene requirements, not complete editing prompt templates. All outputs remain condition=night.

styles.name: 暖橙高压钠灯
styles.mechanism: Localized amber pools with dark intervals; retain variation in material colours, not an orange filter.

styles.name: 窄谱黄色钠灯
styles.mechanism: Yellow-dominant illumination and reduced colour separation around existing or off-frame light sources.

styles.name: 冷白LED
styles.mechanism: Cool-white local illumination, darker gaps and limited highlight bloom.

styles.name: 暖白LED
styles.mechanism: Warm-white pools with natural material colours and a dark nocturnal ambient field.

styles.name: 中性白LED
styles.mechanism: Neutral-white illumination with directional falloff; separate lit surfaces from dark surroundings.

styles.name: 旧式汞灯青绿光
styles.mechanism: Pale greenish-white discharge-light pools; do not colour every pixel green.

styles.name: 金卤灯白光
styles.mechanism: Bright white local illumination with restrained cool shadow cast, avoiding uniformly daytime exposure.

styles.name: 钠灯与LED混合
styles.mechanism: Spatially distinct amber and cool-white illumination zones, not a global cinematic colour grade.

styles.name: 暖窗光与冷路灯
styles.mechanism: Warm light through some existing windows contrasts with cool local exterior illumination.

styles.name: 已有店铺橱窗主照明
styles.mechanism: Light from actual visible shop windows spills onto nearby ground; do not create a store or new sign.

styles.name: 已有标识局部发光
styles.mechanism: Illuminate only an existing sign face; keep its lettering, outline and supporting structure unchanged.

styles.name: 稀疏住宅窗光
styles.mechanism: A subset of existing windows glows softly while upper facades remain nocturnal and recognizable.

styles.name: 入口门廊暖光
styles.mechanism: Light falls locally from an existing entrance or porch area without adding a doorway or fixture.

styles.name: 有顶通道荧光照明
styles.mechanism: Cool fluorescent-like light within an actual covered passage contrasts with the dark exterior.

styles.name: 工业区域安保照明
styles.mechanism: Sparse directional security illumination across existing industrial surfaces; preserve all equipment and layout.

styles.name: 稀疏路灯深夜
styles.mechanism: Widely separated local pools of illumination with useful faint structure between them.

styles.name: 深夜低照度照明
styles.mechanism: Reduced local lighting and fewer illuminated windows; retain enough place evidence without crushing all shadows.

styles.name: 已有车流前灯
styles.mechanism: Light beams and restrained glare belong to visible vehicles; do not conjure headlights without a vehicle.

styles.name: 已有车流尾灯
styles.mechanism: Red tail/brake lights and localized spill associated with appropriate vehicle orientation.

styles.name: 可行新车流照明
styles.mechanism: A plausible passing vehicle may be added in visible free road space, with attached lights and natural perspective.

styles.name: 短车灯拖影
styles.mechanism: Restrained motion streaks confined to moving vehicle lights; buildings and road geometry stay stable.

styles.name: 雨后湿路夜景
styles.mechanism: Wet existing pavement reflects scene-grounded night light; no rain or puddle is mandatory and no new geometry.

styles.name: 潮湿低反光夜景
styles.mechanism: Damp darker pavement with broken, subdued reflections rather than a perfect mirror across the whole road.

styles.name: 轻薄夜雾散射
styles.mechanism: Thin nocturnal atmospheric scattering around plausible lights; nearby structural landmarks remain readable.

styles.name: 月光与弱环境光
styles.mechanism: Weak cool natural ambient illumination with source-specific dark surfaces; a visible moon need not be inserted.

styles.name: 阴天城市夜间天光
styles.mechanism: Diffuse low nocturnal sky glow without daytime sun or daytime facade illumination; no visible sky is required.

styles.name: 蓝调末段入夜
styles.mechanism: Deep-blue late transition into night with clearly nocturnal ground illumination; reject a daylight-looking result.

styles.name: 保高光夜间曝光
styles.mechanism: Exposure protects bright local lights while leaving varied, readable dark structure elsewhere.

styles.name: 自动曝光提亮暗部
styles.mechanism: Moderately lifted shadow detail while keeping a coherent nighttime illumination field; avoid clean daylight relighting.

styles.name: 高ISO纪实夜景
styles.mechanism: Natural high-ISO night rendering with modest grain and localized highlight bloom, without hiding place structure.
